title: Complete the outstanding actions on your Automatic Mutual Recognition notification
summary: This page guides you on how to complete outstanding actions related to your Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR) notification online.
intro:
If you've received an email from the NSW local registration authority advising of an issue with your Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR) notification, you can complete the outstanding actions online.

If there is a mismatch between what you've notified NSW and the confirmation information received from your home state regulator, you may need to contact your home state regulator to resolve the matter.
who_can_apply: Received an email from the NSW local registration authority advising of an issue with your Automatic Mutual Recognition (AMR) notification.
what_you_need: Copies of documents (if requested) in PDF, DOCX, DOC, JPEG, JPG, or PNG format, with a maximum file size of 2MB.

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Complete online' button.Note: You can save and resume your notification, but if you have not submitted it within 60 days, any details you've entered will be deleted.
From 'My Outstanding Items' select the item you need to update.
Follow the prompts to complete the outstanding items.

more_info.text: For more information about AMR, visit Automatic Mutual Recognition.

faqs.q: What should I do if I receive an email about an issue with my AMR notification?
faqs.a: You can complete the outstanding actions online.

faqs.q: What if there is a mismatch between my notification and the information from my home state regulator?
faqs.a: You may need to contact your home state regulator to resolve the matter.

faqs.q: How do I complete the outstanding actions online?
faqs.a: Select 'Complete online', log into your MyServiceNSW Account, select the item from 'My Outstanding Items', and follow the prompts.
